An '''algorithm''' was a step-by-step procedure for calculations. It was essentially a finite list of well-defined instructions for calculating a function. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Osss-10]] used algorithms to intercept predetermined flight patterns leaving his enemies with few choices to escape. An unknown [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was once said to have calculated the [[Jedi Algorithm]].
